story.title: Our story
paragraphs: Pride Idea Artificial Intelligence Systems started in Sana'a in 2023 and was officially founded in January 2024, driven by the conviction that Arab organizations deserve AI solutions that understand their language, environment and needs.

We began with a simple question: why do customer messages get lost, the same questions repeat, and procedures stay manual even though the technology exists? From that question we built digital assistants and intelligent platforms now running at organizations in the education and finance sectors.

products.name: DarAI
products.title: All your customer conversations in one place
products.description: An intelligent Arabic platform for managing customer conversations and service. It brings WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and your website into one inbox, and replies, routes and analyzes with AI.
problem: Customer messages are scattered across many channels, and some get lost.
Replies are slow, and nobody answers outside working hours.
It's unclear who owns each conversation or how the team is performing.
The same questions come up every day.
process: The customer sends a message on any channel.
DarAI understands the request and searches your organization's knowledge.
It replies instantly, or hands the conversation to the right employee with full context.
It carries out the required action and logs everything in reports.
features: Unified inbox: text, images, voice notes and files in one interface.
Smart replies: understands customer intent and conversation context, and suggests replies to agents.
Knowledge base: upload your documents so the assistant answers from them accurately.
Team management: conversation routing, role-based permissions and per-agent performance tracking.
Unified customer profile: a complete history for every customer across all channels.
Automation: rules that trigger actions and call your systems automatically.
Menus and buttons: interactive menus linked to your services and data.
Reports: response times, open and closed conversations, and the most frequent questions.
products.channels: WhatsApp Business · Facebook Messenger · Instagram · Website chat · Custom channels via API
products.integrations: CRM systems · ERP systems · University systems · Financial systems · Webhooks
products.security: Full data isolation for every organization, role-based permissions, encrypted connections and an audit log of every operation.
products.deployment: Cloud · On your servers · Sovereign deployment with full data control

products.name: PrideScreen
products.title: Smart screening for safer customers
products.description: A platform that screens your customers and partners against blacklists, sanctions and watch lists, reducing compliance risk before you start doing business.
features: Name screening against sanctions, watch lists and blacklists.
Smart name matching that accounts for Arabic and English spelling variations.
A clear screening result that helps compliance officers decide.
A complete log of every screening for audit purposes.
Support for due diligence, KYC and anti-money-laundering procedures.

products.name: PridePass
products.title: Digital verification that builds trust
products.description: A remote electronic identity verification system (eKYC) that onboards customers quickly and protects your organization from identity fraud.
audiences: Any organization that needs to verify customer identity
process: The customer photographs their ID document.
The system extracts the data automatically and checks its legibility.
It matches the customer's face with the document photo.
Your organization receives a clear verification result.
features: Faster customer onboarding without a branch visit.
Less identity theft and fraud.
A fully digital onboarding experience.

products.name: Smart Invitations
products.title: Organized events, invitations that can't be forged
products.description: An end-to-end system for managing events and invitations that gives every guest a unique QR code and verifies it at the entrance.
features: Create events and manage guest lists.
Digital invitations with a unique QR code for every guest.
Set how many people each invitation admits.
Verification at the gate that prevents invitation reuse.
Attendance tracking and instant reports.
Electronic certificates for participants.
Support for hybrid events via Zoom.

faq.q: Do I need technical expertise to use your solutions?
faq.a: No. We handle setup and integration and train your team for day-to-day use.

faq.q: Where is my organization's data stored?
faq.a: You choose: in the cloud, on your own servers, or in a sovereign deployment that gives you full control over your data.

faq.q: Do your solutions understand local dialects?
faq.a: Yes. Our solutions are built for Arabic and are trained on your customers' language and way of expressing themselves.

faq.q: Can your solutions connect to our existing systems?
faq.a: Yes. We connect to CRM, ERP, financial systems and databases through APIs.

faq.q: Does the digital assistant replace employees?
faq.a: No. It handles repetitive questions and hands complex cases to the right employee with the full conversation context.
It depends on the scope and the integrations required. We set an accurate timeline after the discovery session.

faq.q: Do you offer a trial before purchase?
faq.a: Yes, we offer a demo [and a trial period for some products].
